name: alpha-steps
airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: TRANSIENT half of the alpha pair (alpha-sweep is the sustained half). Mirrored +-45 deg pitch steps at 8000 m: thin air is the airframe-agnostic lever that makes the WING hit its alpha ceiling before the g-limit, and a 45 deg step is the fast pull the v0.57 predictive gate exists for. The arm between the steps returns to level so both are true 45 deg steps from the same datum; they are NOT matched in entry ENERGY (see cards/README.md). AIRFRAME: the eight fixed-wing keys that clear the v0.92 envelope gate (1.10x Vstall .. 0.95x Vmax) at this card's 250 m/s - CAS1 (0.95x Vmax = 195.3), COIN (134.6) and all three rotorcraft would be refused pre-spawn. The list is the point of the card as much as the geometry is: 'a loaded jet mushing near its alpha limit' is a ONE-LAW clause, and until this list existed the field was blank and a fleet launch silently flew one Ifrit at the Cfg default. It does NOT cover the loaded case - a card cannot set a loadout - so fly it again by hand with heavy stores.
